steps.title: Goal
body: Crack a secret 4-color code.
You get up to 7 guesses; match exactly to win.
Use all 7 without matching and you lose — retry anytime.

steps.title: Campaign & Endless
body: Easy: per-column green / white / off — great for learning.
Advanced: only totals of greens and whites, no column marks.
Nightmare: more colors, repeats allowed, countdown — timeout or 7 misses loses.
Endless: one timed streak of codes; a miss or timeout ends the run — chase your best streak.
Campaign progress is saved per mode; Endless tracks best streak separately.

steps.title: Timers
body: Easy / Advanced: count up from 00:00; results show time and local bests.
Nightmare / Endless: countdown; opening help or hiding the tab pauses the clock.
Nightmare bests use elapsed time (limit minus remaining) — shorter is better.
The last ~10 seconds show a light cue (mute sound; reduced motion softens animation).

steps.title: Controls
body: Tap a cell to select; tap again to cycle colors.
Bottom palette fills the current slot in one tap.
Knob: drag to cycle · short press to move · long press to submit; or press Enter.

steps.title: Green & white
body: Green: right color in the right place.
White: color is in the code, wrong place.
Off: that color is not in the code.

steps.title: Practice & settings
body: Solo advances level by level; progress stays on this device.
Custom lets you tune the difficulty preset, colors, repeats, hints, and timer — no campaign progress.
Turn on “Preset secret” so a friend sets the code, you hand over the device, then you crack it (local duo).
Change language, theme, and sound under Settings & more.
Open this guide via in-game “? Help” or press “H”.

steps.title: Keyboard
body: On desktop you can play with the keyboard (touch and mouse still work):

shortcuts.action: Fill the current slot with that color
Cycle the color in the current cell
Close a dialog, or return to the menu
